tasks.question: Does a named residual packing task have meaningful uncovered headroom after its exact fixed-inventory ceiling?
methods: Check a fixed-inventory ceiling and source equivalence before any explicitly bounded residual search.
Price a genuinely changed word/interface under a newly applicable model.
tasks.acceptance_gate: Check live overlap and exact model/source binding first. Distinguish a chronological construction from a pooled optimum. State the applicable fixed-inventory ceiling and remaining headroom; changed words or interfaces require a new fully charged model. Do not launch a residual search without an explicit scope and time cap.

first_step.inspect: Read #4091 fixed-word pooled ceiling and #4088 later 1090-call literal fill. Bind the unchanged local invoices/capacities/stock before transferring the ceiling; its earlier 1080-call residual-bin recipe is historical.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

tasks.first_experiment: Default to a bounded headroom/source-equivalence check. Only start residual search with an explicit unclaimed domain, time cap and reason the tiny remaining gain matters. Otherwise hand off or select a changed-word mechanism. A changed word or interface needs a fresh cost model, not the old ceiling. Stop at the fixed-inventory cap; do not extend by new random seeds.
tasks.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.
